units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:2">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>נעשה ס׳ לכל וכ׳</he> (the serpent) has become the executioner for all who break down fences (of customs, with ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:8">Koh. X, 8</cite>).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:3">Lam. R. to II, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְפִקְלָטוֹרִים</he>, <he>סְפִקְלָטוֹרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:3">Ib.</cite> introd. (R. Josh. 2) <he>לפתח … ספקלטרים</he> ‘to open the mouth for murder’ (<cite ref="Ezekiel 21:27">Ezek. XXI, 27</cite>) refers to the executioners.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite> <he>סְפִקְלָטוֹרֵי פרעה</he> (not <cite ref="O01262"><he>סנקלטורי</he></cite>) Pharaoh’s executioners; a. e.
